name: agora-sdk-plus
author: Agora SDK Plus, maintained by Jenova Marie
description: Additive, Agora-only SDK features that build on @agora-sdk/* — starting with end-to-end-encrypted secure chat (MLS / RFC 9420).

scripts.build-all: pnpm --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-crypto run build && pnpm --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-core run build && pnpm --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-react-js run build && pnpm --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-react-native run build && pnpm --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-expo run build && pnpm --filter @agora-sdk/social-core run build && pnpm --filter @agora-sdk/social-react-js run build && pnpm --filter @agora-sdk/social-react-native run build && pnpm --filter @agora-sdk/social-expo run build && pnpm --filter @agora-sdk/auth-react-js run build
scripts.version:patch: pnpm --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-crypto --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-core --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-react-js --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-react-native --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-expo --filter @agora-sdk/social-core --filter @agora-sdk/social-react-js --filter @agora-sdk/social-react-native --filter @agora-sdk/social-expo --filter @agora-sdk/auth-react-js exec npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/write-version.mjs
scripts.version:minor: pnpm --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-crypto --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-core --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-react-js --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-react-native --filter @agora-sdk/secure-chat-expo --filter @agora-sdk/social-core --filter @agora-sdk/social-react-js --filter @agora-sdk/social-react-native --filter @agora-sdk/social-expo --filter @agora-sdk/auth-react-js exec npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/write-version.mjs
